Against that, the signals point to a dying coin. It is down 72.7% over 30 minutes and 74.5% over the last 15, with a 86.7% drawdown from its 30-minute high. Sellers (407) outnumber buyers (356) in the recent window, and sell SOL exceeded buy SOL by about 33. The sell-to-buy ratio in the launch window was 1.03, meaning early buyers were already exiting. Real demand that persists for 30-60 minutes would show up as recovering flow, not a 75% slide with more sellers than buyers. I can't find a case that it will still be here in that window. Recommendation: skip.
